name: vf-2
description: Világítani Fogok – Ghost téma + helyi Docker környezet

scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.e2e: docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD:/work" mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.55.0-noble sh -c "cd /tmp && npm i --no-save playwright@1.55.0 >/dev/null 2>&1 && cp /work/scripts/e2e.mjs . && OUT=/work/screenshots node e2e.mjs"
scripts.screenshots: docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD:/work" mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.55.0-noble sh -c "cd /tmp && npm i --no-save playwright@1.55.0 >/dev/null 2>&1 && cp /work/scripts/screenshots.mjs . && OUT=/work/screenshots node screenshots.mjs"
